name: mark_on_picture
description: Circles a part on the technician's camera picture. You give the part's name; a careful look at the full picture finds it. Returns whether it was found.

label.description: The part's name in {{language}}, two or three words. With pointing true: leave empty.

english.description: The part's name in English, as a manual would call it.

state.description: current: being discussed now. checked: confirmed fine. caution: keep away or take care.

pointing.description: True when the technician points at something with a finger.
